links.outcome: Discrepancies between ML antimicrobial recommendations and standard guidelines, as reviewed by independent clinicians
links.effect: Among 644 clinician-trained reports, there were no major discrepancies in recommendations, and only 100 showed minor differences.
links.quote: Among 644 clinician-trained reports, there were no major discrepancies in recommendations, with only 100 showing minor differences.

unlisted_practices: Testing an ML system's ability to distinguish trained from novel data using cross-validation techniques and BioFire molecular panel inputs

screen.reason: Internal validation study evaluating the technical performance and clinical guideline alignment of a machine learning-based clinical decision support system for antimicrobial stewardship.
